title: packet-scope OID string kept in a global and read by a later packet's parameters decode
live_proof: absent at the 4.6.8 pin by inspection: the global is gone and cms_get_private_data allocates the OID holder from pinfo->pool in epan/dissectors/packet-cms.c. The pre-fix shape is quoted from c14d731e45^ at packet-cms.c:314 (the global), :1722 (the store in T_capability) and :1742 (the read in T_parameters).
object: the OID string built by oid_encoded2string, 59 bytes in packet scope
lifetime_ender: wmem_leave_packet_scope at the end of the packet's dissection (epan.c:617 at the fix's parent); the global keeps the pointer
shape: stale pointer held by a global across packets
distinguishing: the read is a strlen (g_strdup inside find_string_dtbl_entry), reached only when the later packet's capability decode fails non-fatally before it re-sets the global
sibling_issue: #17935 and #17809 are further reports closed by the same fix; #17935's trace is identical to this one
